key_findings.value: The 15Al alloy aged at 625 °C for 6 h shows a Vickers hardness of 887.2 ± 14.1 HV; at 625 °C and 650 °C the hardness stabilizes between 800 HV and 900 HV with prolonged aging.

unmapped_findings: In the 15Al alloy, aging at 625 °C and 650 °C stabilizes the Vickers hardness between 800 HV and 900 HV with prolonged aging time; the 625 °C/6 h value (887.2 ± 14.1 HV) lies within this plateau (b0037).
The optimal aging temperature range for achieving ultra-high hardness in the 15Al alloy is mainly 525 °C–600 °C, so the 625 °C aging condition lies above the optimal window for this alloy (b0038).
